title: fix(plugin-detail): fold a declared pointer pair type half into its record card (objectui#13102)
body:
Fixes #13102
Clause-②: no

## What changes

`record:details` no longer draws a record pointer pair's type half as its own row. An object can declare a polymorphic pointer as a pair: the id half (`record_id`) names its sibling with `referenceVia` (`object_name`). `DetailSection` already draws the id half as the record card, headed by the target object's label. The type half also drew as a row of stored machine name beside that card.

`foldPointerTypeHalves` in `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx` runs after every other fold (field security, the strip dedupe, the H1 dedupe). It reads the object's declared fields: every field with a non-empty `referenceVia` that names a declared sibling forms a pair. When the id half is drawn anywhere in this body (the direct `fields` list or any section, `{ group }` references included, since they resolve before the fold), the type half leaves every list of the body.

- **Declared pair only.** No field name is read. A text field called `object_name` that no field names in `referenceVia` still draws.
- **Only the row goes.** The record (`ctx.data`) is untouched, so the card still resolves the pair from the type half's value, and every other reader still reads it.
- **Unchanged:** an object with no pair, and the id half's card.

One choice beyond the card's wording: the type half is folded only when its id half is drawn in the same body. If the body does not draw the id half (for example, the author listed `object_name` but not `record_id`), no card on this body names the target object, so the type half keeps its row. Without this condition, the object type would be shown nowhere on the body. Pinned by the third case below.

No export, prop, key or spec surface moves. The helper is module-private.

## Tests

New: `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-details.pointerTypeHalf-13102.test.tsx`, through the real `RecordDetailsRenderer` in a `RecordContextProvider`, with a probe face registered under `RECORD_POINTER_CARD_TYPE`:

1. (a) a pair, `sections` body: one card, and it receives `{ objectName: 'invoice', recordId: 'inv_1' }` (so the type half still feeds the card). No `Target Object Type` label and no `invoice` text in the body.
2. (a) a pair, direct `fields` body: the same fold.
3. a pair whose id half the body does not draw: the type half keeps its row.
4. (b) control: the same field names with no `referenceVia` draw every listed field, `object_name` included.

Both fixtures declare `nameField: 'name'`, so the page-H1 dedupe takes `name` and none of the fields under test. A first run without it showed the H1 dedupe hiding `object_name` on the control object.

**Ablation** (via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in the objectstack checkout, anchor `const body = foldPointerTypeHalves(filteredFields, filteredSections, objSchemaFields);` replaced with the unfolded pass-through), on HEAD `5a5fd3415e`: anchor 1 to 0, blob `90106dfff7e2` to `570f6724e181`. Cases 1 and 2 went red (`Tests 2 failed | 2 passed (4)`), and the controls stayed green. Restore: blob after restore `90106dfff7e2` equals the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The test imports the renderer by relative path from `src`, so no `dist` build sits between the mutation and the run. The same ablation also ran on the first commit `83fdc295c0`, with the same result.
